_comment: Sync page copy (T11.3a). problems: the last sync's status, by word. command_problems: a button press that failed, by word (nothing retries those). Pinned to sync_settings::problem_copy and command_copy by the desktop's tests and read by the UI mock. Shipped with the app: public copy only.

problems.unreachable: The sync server could not be reached. Earshot will try again.
problems.server: The sync server gave an answer Earshot does not understand. Earshot will try again.
problems.unknown_device: This computer was removed from sync. Remove it here, then join again with a pairing code.
problems.key_mismatch: This sync server already belongs to other devices. Join it with a pairing code from one of them.
problems.update_needed: Another device uses a newer Earshot. Update Earshot on this computer to keep syncing.
problems.slow_down: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again.
problems.too_large: Something was too large for the sync server. Earshot will try again.
problems.bad_secret: That setup secret is not the server's.
problems.no_slot: That pairing code is not one the server holds. It may be used or out of date: show a new one on the other device.
problems.bad_code: That is not a pairing code. Check it and type it again.
problems.device_exists: This computer is already registered with the server. Set it up with the server's setup secret instead.
problems.address: The sync server's address is not usable. Remove this computer from sync and set it up again.
problems.vault: This computer's sync key is missing. Remove this computer from sync and set it up again.
problems.store: Earshot could not read or save its own data for sync. It will try again.
problems.internal: Something went wrong inside sync. Restart Earshot to try again.
